rationale: Candidate for user review, selected before any new candidate measurement. Baseline-only latency relative MAD was 0.79-6.11 percent in one invocation; XLSX wall/RSS had only three samples and do not establish stability.
activation: Requires explicit numeric-policy agreement plus at least three independent comparable baseline invocations. Latency needs at least 15 measured samples per run; XLSX at least seven. Excessive between-run noise remains INCOMPLETE; tolerances are never automatically widened.
